thread:
maria: Heads-up — onboarding sampleapp streaming weirdness. After a token refresh during a long SSE session, we sometimes get chunk ordering issues and duplicate delimiters, causing JSON parse errors on the client. Repro steps below, anyone seen this?

sam: Browser or node? Which sdk version?

maria: Node 18, sampleapp v0.3.2, js-sdk 1.4.5. Flow: token issued short-lived (~30s), client refreshes mid-stream -> we detect auth failure, swap token and reconnect. Intermittently the stream emits fragments that arrive out of order and some `\n\n` delimiters end up duplicated or split across reconnects.

maria: Repro curl minimal:```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <short-lived>" -N https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
# trigger client-side refresh while stream is active (simulate expiry)
```

sam: Can you paste a raw fragment sequence you saw? Splits in the `data:` lines or the final blank line?

maria: Example chunk sequence from logs (weird line breaks preserved):```
data: {"id":1,"text":"hello"}\n\n:data: {"id":2,"text":"wo\nrld"}\ndata: {"id":3,"text":"!"}\n\n```

maria: Note the `:data:` line — that came from a keepalive/colon-prefixed comment merging with a new `data:` because our reconnect reassembled buffers incorrectly. Client then tries to JSON.parse on a half fragment.

ben: Sounds like a race where the proxy/transport merges leftover bytes from old connection with the new one. Two things to check: 1) ensure the client sends `Last-Event-ID` on reconnect so server can resume deterministically, 2) make the reassembly logic require the terminal `\n\n` before emitting a message (buffer until full delimiter).

carol: Also watch for overlapping refresh attempts — if auth refresh happens twice fast you can have parallel reconnects that interleave fragments. We fixed a similar bug by serializing reconnect attempts with a tiny backoff. Link: https://go.redwood/ci/stream-reconnect (internal).

maria: Good points. Our sampleapp sets `Last-Event-ID` for fetch reconnects but not the SDK socket path — will add that. I'll also buffer until `\n\n` and drop lone `:` keepalive lines before parsing.

devx-bot: Created issue #1342: sse-reconnect-fragment-race — labels: devex, streaming, urgent.

maria: Assigning @sam to prototype the buffering + Last-Event-ID patch in the sampleapp. I'll attach a minimal repro and tests. Thanks :thumbsup:
